_doc: An MR105 miniature ball bearing, 5 x 10 mm. The width depends on the seals: the open bearing is 3 mm and the shielded MR105ZZ is 4 mm (the default here, as usually sold; variant open gives 3). Maker's drawings were not found, so these figures, from distributors, are community until measured. Ratings differ by maker and by seal type: see the rule text. kind as in x1c.json. Bore along z, one face at z = 0.
